text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in their DM. Moss's notes that Dana can access mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's Sunday prep note of 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and the customer contact confirmed the fix the next day.
- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It was escalated to tier-2 support for firmware testing. Because the cheat sheet has no date, I couldn't say when this ticket was opened.

I left out three tickets on purpose:
- **#4409, #4412 and FR-882** belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.
- **Marcus's note** is about Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer.

I only used files Dana can open (the public team digests). I didn't use message search and didn't read any channel, so the list doesn't draw on anything Dana couldn't see. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed to share them with Dana.
